bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo ROOTS
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/g/GserverStorage /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos;do
 if test -e "$p";then ls -ld "$p";else echo "PATH_NOT_PRESENT=$p";fi
done
echo MOUNTS
findmnt --target /mnt/g || true
findmnt --target /mnt/g/GserverStorage || true
echo CURRENT_USER
id -un
echo GDRIVE_SERVICE_NAMES
systemctl --user list-units --all --no-pager --no-legend '*gdrive*' '*g-drive*' '*GserverStorage*' || true
echo RESIDENT
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
echo OTHER_ALL_JOB_STATES
for u in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service;do echo "$u=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || true)";done
